R531.note: instance.full_clean()+save() correctly triggers validate_file_content, but a raised django.core.exceptions.ValidationError there is not caught by DRF's default exception_handler (only Http404/PermissionDenied/APIException, per DRF source) so a rejected upload surfaces as an unhandled 500, not the 'handled as serializer validation error' the write-up claims.

R532.note: html.escape() blocks literal HTML/script text, but render_template_string() treats the whole concatenated string as Jinja source and curly braces are not escaped, so a `{{ ... }}` payload in the search term still executes as SSTI and can emit unescaped HTML, defeating the fix for this specific sink.

R533.note: reorders the session write to after login_user() with no other behavioral change; matches the case's intended fix exactly.

R534.note: Math.multiplyExact + catch(ArithmeticException) matches the stated contract exactly: still writes allocated length as text on success, still 400 on overflow or out-of-range input.

R536.note: parameterizes the whole LIKE value including wildcards; preserves substring-match semantics and closes the injection exactly as the stated contract requires.

R537.note: json_encode with HEX flags is the correct JS-string-context encoding for this sink; round-trips legitimate values unchanged.

R538.note: eliminates all code-injection risk, but replaces the endpoint's actual purpose (arbitrary vetted Python transformation scripts) with 4 hardcoded functions, so any real prior script is now rejected; this capability loss is stated openly in the explanation rather than hidden.

R540.note: removing [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken] restores the app-wide AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenAttribute with no other change; matches the case's own comment about the intended fix.

R541.note: correct swap to RandomNumberGenerator; minor inconsistency where the explanation says to remove the now-unused seed parameter but the shown code keeps it (harmless either way).
